sentences: In 2021, seven people walked out of OpenAI.
Five years later, the company they started just filed to go public.
Revenue in the first half of 2026: sixteen point three billion dollars.
A year earlier, it was one point two billion.
And in the same filing, the company warns that its own AI could pose catastrophic risks to humanity.
So why would anyone build it?
This is the story of Anthropic.
